_comment: The self-deploy manifest (DR-0236): repo-declared NAS services the services-sync loop installs/repairs on the NAS's own clock. Each entry is an IDEMPOTENT installer script (safe to run every cycle; every step no-ops when already done). Adding a service here + merging to main IS its deploy -- the nas mirror pulls, services-sync runs the installer, the service starts. 'enabled' is the committed greenlight. Installers never edit configs they cannot verify (DR-0076).

services.name: mcp
services.description: Sovereign MCP server (poetech-mcp.service on 127.0.0.1:8795, MCP 2026-07-28 stateless, READ-ONLY v1 over dispatch reel / task snapshot / Cage brake view) + token + venv + best-effort Caddy /mcp snippet. DR-0244.

services.name: scribe
services.description: Scribe ingest server (poetech-scribe.service on 127.0.0.1:8791) + data dir + token + venv + best-effort Caddy /scribe/* snippet. Pairs with the scribe-transcribe loop (the braked whisper-queue consumer).

services.name: property-photos
services.description: Sovereign property/family/album photo image server (photo_server.py, poetech-photo-server.service on 127.0.0.1:8099, reached via the same-origin /nas-photos route). Ends the 'NAS deploy pending Darrell' hand-deploy class: merge installs/repairs/starts it (DR-0268). Token kept, never regenerated over a live one.

services.name: funnel
services.description: Ensure the public Funnel serves the RECORDED-STATE sovereign rows (/mcp, /nas-photos) — the funnel_watchdog.py restore riding the ALREADY-ARMED services-sync clock, so the 2026-08-03 dark-funnel class heals with ZERO new DSM entries (Darrell: humans don't do anything). Idempotent and silent when the endpoint answers; bounded re-assert + one package restart when dark (DR-0268; RECORDED-STATE rule 1).

services.name: ytzero
services.description: YT Zero (ghcr.io/pelski/ytzero pinned 0.25.3) -- sovereign chosen-channels-only YouTube inbox on host port 3701. Public RSS -> own SQLite at /volume1/docker/ytzero; no Google account, no API key, no recommendation feed; optional yt-dlp downloads; LAN/Tailscale only. Runbook: infra/nas-ytzero/README.md.
